service_at_issue: Inpatient rehabilitation facility (IRF) services for five beneficiaries, March 2003 to May 2004
outcome_note: The Council modified the ALJ decisions (the ALJ lacked authority to review the RAC's reopening and should have applied the three-year no-fault presumption, which was rebutted) but upheld the overpayments, provider liability and denial of waiver because the IRF services were not reasonable and necessary.
facts: This appeal involves IRF services provided by the appellant to five beneficiaries on various dates between March 2003 and May 2004. See Appendix A. The claims were initially paid between April 2003 and June 2004.
Dr. K.F., appellant’s Medical Director, testified.
[For example,] [w]ith respect to payments made in 2000, the third calendar year thereafter is 2003.
